modules.title: Tracking team work in Jira
modules.outcome: Create, assign and progress work items on a team board, and explain each status change so a colleague can follow the work.

resource.title: How a team board tells the story of the work

parts.heading: A work item is one piece of work
parts.text: Each item has a short summary that says what will be done, for example “Clean turnaround-time data for Terminal 3”. If you cannot finish it in a few days, split it.

parts.heading: Every item has one owner
parts.text: The assignee is the person who will move it forward. Unassigned work is invisible work: nobody is accountable for it.

parts.heading: Status shows where the work is
parts.text: Items move from To do, to In progress, to Done. Move an item when its real state changes, not to look busy.

parts.heading: Explain the change
parts.text: When you move an item, leave a one-line reason: what changed and what happens next. This is the record your supervisor and team read.

modules.task: Your ground-operations analytics team is starting a sprint. On the simulated board, create at least two work items, assign an owner to every item, move one item from To do through In progress to Done, and give a reason for each status change. Then submit the board with a short explanation.
checklist: Creates at least two work items with clear, specific summaries
Gives every work item an owner
Moves at least one item from To do through In progress to Done
Explains each status change in plain language
